fields.description:
## Context / Problem
Pydantic AI 1.107 warns that `openai:` will change from Chat Completions to Responses in v2. Rebar currently relies on Chat Completions for hosted OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so leaving the ambiguous prefix would silently change the wire contract on upgrade. The operator approved preserving Chat Completions with `openai-chat:`; story `upbeat-illadvised-springtail` owns the eventual deliberate Responses migration.

## Approach
Normalize every rebar-composed or legacy `openai:` Pydantic AI model target to the explicit `openai-chat:` qualifier at the shared primary and model-class/fallback resolution seams. Update both independent ProviderSession gates: the cfg.base_url builder registration and the per-candidate endpoint-override guard must recognize `openai-chat`, so local OpenAI-compatible endpoints keep their provider/profile override. Preserve other provider qualifiers unchanged and document `openai-chat:` as the supported Chat Completions spelling.

## Scope
- Update `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py` and `src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py` so inferred, explicitly qualified, primary, and fallback OpenAI targets resolve to `openai-chat:`.
- Update both `openai`-keyed gates in `src/rebar/llm/providers.py`: cfg.base_url builder registration and the per-candidate endpoint-override guard.
- Strengthen provider-resolution, custom-endpoint, fallback, and library-contract tests in `tests/unit/test_pydantic_ai_runner.py`, `tests/unit/test_openai_compatible_provider.py`, `tests/unit/test_provider_qualifier.py`, `tests/unit/test_model_classes.py`, and `tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_framework.py`.
- Update `docs/llm-framework.md`, `docs/llm-example-configs.md`, and `docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md` to recommend `openai-chat:` while leaving the future Responses migration to `upbeat-illadvised-springtail`.
- The nine `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/*.eval.yaml` grader strings are out of scope: current `run_eval` executes only deterministic scorers and never constructs those report-only grader models, so they cannot emit this warning; the deliberate Responses migration story can revisit them if an executable judge path is added.

## Testing
- Run a warning-as-error oracle through real `infer_model` for inferred, explicit, custom-endpoint, and fallback paths; it must fail before the repair and pass without `PydanticAIDeprecationWarning` afterward.
- Run real loopback custom-endpoint tests and provider/fallback parity tests to prove Chat Completions payloads, endpoint routing, and structured-output profile behavior are preserved.
- Sweep all unit tests with `PydanticAIDeprecationWarning` promoted to error, then run repository lint and typecheck.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Inferred OpenAI targets resolve to `openai-chat:`; verified by provider-resolution tests.
- [ ] Legacy-explicit `openai:` targets resolve to `openai-chat:`; verified by interface tests.
- [ ] Primary and fallback model-class targets resolve to `openai-chat:`; verified by model-class tests.
- [ ] Real model construction emits no `PydanticAIDeprecationWarning` with that warning promoted to error.
- [ ] Loopback custom endpoints still receive Chat Completions payloads; verified by real-seam provider tests.
- [ ] The custom-endpoint profile override remains active on cfg.base_url and per-candidate endpoint paths.
- [ ] Non-OpenAI targets and provider-conflict checks remain unchanged; verified by provider-parity tests.
- [ ] User-facing LLM examples use `openai-chat:` for Chat Completions.
- [ ] Focused tests, repository lint, and typecheck pass.
